description.elemenix.analysis_terminal: The Elemenic Analysis Terminal is the ultimate integrated portable instrument of elemenic engineering. It can automatically retrieve the items placed in the player's analyzer and memorizer box slots, integrating functions such as deconstruction, reconstruction, and memorization.
description.elemenix.analytical_wrench: The Analytical Wrench is the advanced version of the ordinary Wrench, incorporating advanced information engineering technology. When the player holds the Analytical Wrench, the elemenix-type device block being pointed at will display its current state, such as its elemenix reserves. Of course, all the functions of the ordinary Wrench are fully retained by the Analytical Wrench.
description.elemenix.analyzing_chip: The Analyzing Chip is an essential component for elemenic analysis. The Elemenic Analyzer, Elemenic Storage, Elemenic Scanner, Elemenic Deconstructor, Elemenic Comparator, Substance Printer, and Elemenic Analysis Terminal all rely on its powerful computing power.
description.elemenix.arcanix_essence: Arcanix is the root of all that is 'supernatural', hidden within every magic and miracle, marking the elemenicians' endless pursuit of the unknown. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Arcanix can be condensed into Arcanix Essence for storage.
description.elemenix.arcanix_essenplex: Arcanix is the root of all that is 'supernatural', hidden within every magic and miracle, marking the elemenicians' endless pursuit of the unknown. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Arcanix can be condensed into Arcanix Essenplex for storage.
description.elemenix.elemenic_analyzer: The Elemenic Analyzer is a portable hub for elemenix deconstruction and reconstruction, the crystallization of wisdom handed down through generations of elemenicians. Players can use it to deconstruct items into their corresponding elemenix and store it inside, then enrich the elemenix into the corresponding essence or essenplex. When an Elemenic Memorizer is inserted, the information of the deconstructed items will be memorized, after which the memorizer's memory list can be used to reconstruct elemenix back into items, realizing the 'item-elemenix-item' cycle.
description.elemenix.elemenic_channel: The Elemenic Channel is the conduit for elemenix transportation, used to connect an Elemenic Outlet to elemenix-input blocks, and can be turned. The Elemenic Channel has a strict direction; an incorrect direction will break the flow. Right-clicking with a Wrench reverses its direction.
description.elemenix.elemenic_chaos: The Elemenic Chaos is a swirling substance formed by mixing elemenix in large, uniform quantities. As the balance among the elemenix breaks, matter collapses into indistinguishable chaos here — an unstable 'absolute stability'.
description.elemenix.elemenic_comparator: The Elemenic Comparator is the interface between redstone and elemenix-type devices. It can output a redstone signal based on the elemenix stored in an elemenix device. The Elemenic Comparator's comparison criteria are highly adjustable, enabling complex automation functions. Elemenic Comparators connected in the same direction can also be chained to perform an AND operation between their criteria.
description.elemenix.elemenic_deconstruc: The Elemenic Deconstructor is used to automatically deconstruct items placed inside it. The elemenix obtained can then be transferred to other devices using an Elemenic Outlet. When it receives a redstone signal, its deconstruction function is locked.
description.elemenix.elemenic_ejector: The Elemenic Ejector can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and restrict the types of elemenix output from its front. The ejector's other faces can only output the five elemenix types not specified for the front. When it receives a redstone signal, the front stops outputting while other faces remain unaffected.
description.elemenix.elemenic_enricher: The Elemenic Enricher can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and automatically enrich the stored elemenix into the corresponding essence. When it receives a redstone signal, its enriching function is locked. If the enricher's stored essence is full, it will stop working; use a hopper to extract the products in time.
description.elemenix.elemenic_equilibriu: The Elemenic Equilibrium is a uniform mixture of the six essences, seemingly reaching a subtle balance.
description.elemenix.elemenic_equiliplex: The Elemenic Equiliplex is a uniform mixture of the six essenplexes, seemingly reaching the limit of mutual restraint among the elemenix.
description.elemenix.elemenic_infuser: The Elemenic Infuser can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and automatically transfer the stored elemenix into an Elemenic Analyzer or Elemenic Storage. When it receives a redstone signal, its infusion function is locked. Additionally, the Elemenic Infuser can establish a remote connection with a Remote Elemenic Storage to remotely access the elemenix stored in it.
description.elemenix.elemenic_memorizer: The Elemenic Memorizer is a tool for memorizing the elemenix information of items. When placed into the corresponding slot of an Elemenic Analyzer, the items deconstructed by the analyzer will be memorized by it. At the same time, the analyzer can read the memorized item list in the memorizer, and the player can click an item to reconstruct it, converting elemenix back into items. Dyes and certain materials can be used to change the memorizer's style, and honeycomb can be used to set the memorizer to read-only mode to prevent other players from modifying its memories. The player who set it to read-only can use an axe to remove its read-only state.
description.elemenix.elemenic_outlet: The Elemenic Outlet is the starting point of elemenix transportation. It extracts elemenix from elemenix-output blocks and transfers it to elemenix-input devices through Elemenic Channels. When it receives a redstone signal, its transportation function is locked. Players can click to open the outlet screen and adjust the maximum output per operation for each elemenix type.
description.elemenix.elemenic_pressurize: The Elemenic Pressurized Outlet is the upgraded version of the Elemenic Outlet. Its functions are exactly the same as the ordinary outlet, but thanks to the pressurization of the Piston Pump, its maximum output is twice that of the ordinary outlet.
description.elemenix.elemenic_scanner: The Elemenic Scanner is used to scan the block the player is pointing at and display the elemenix constituents of that block's corresponding item. The player can also hold the Elemenic Scanner and click a container-type block to obtain the total elemenix of all items in that container.
description.elemenix.elemenic_shunt: The Elemenic Shunt filters and screens elemenix. Six shunts with the same facing, touching each other, on the same plane and each specifying a different elemenix must bind together before they can work. A bound shunt group shares one elemenix inventory and can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels. Outputting from a bound shunt's front only outputs its specified elemenix type. Upon receiving a redstone signal, the whole group stops front output while other faces remain unaffected.
description.elemenix.elemenic_storage: The Elemenic Storage is used to temporarily hold the elemenix stored by the Elemenic Infuser, and can also establish a connection with a Remote Elemenic Storage. When needed, the player can transfer the elemenix from the storage into an Elemenic Analyzer, using a method similar to deconstructing items.
description.elemenix.elemenic_tank: The Elemenic Tank can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and transfer the stored elemenix to other elemenix containers through an Elemenic Outlet. When it receives a redstone signal, the tank stops elemenix input, but output remains unaffected. When the Elemenic Tank is broken, the elemenix stored inside is preserved in the dropped item.
description.elemenix.energix_essence: Energix is the warm wings of light and heat, the ceaseless driving force of electricity and magnetism, embodying all the energy in the world. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Energix can be condensed into Energix Essence for storage.
description.elemenix.energix_essenplex: Energix is the warm wings of light and heat, the ceaseless driving force of electricity and magnetism, embodying all the energy in the world. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Energix can be condensed into Energix Essenplex for storage.
description.elemenix.flow_straightener: The Flow Straightener is a device that regulates the direction and velocity distribution of fluid flow, and is used to craft the Elemenic Outlet, Elemenic Ejector, and Elemenic Shunt.
description.elemenix.flumix_essence: Flumix is the breath of streams and oceans, and the soul of atmosphere and mist. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Flumix can be condensed into Flumix Essence for storage.
description.elemenix.flumix_essenplex: Flumix is the breath of streams and oceans, and the soul of atmosphere and mist. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Flumix can be condensed into Flumix Essenplex for storage.
description.elemenix.fondant_cake: A dessert full of food coloring and every elemenician's favorite. Be careful not to confuse it with an Elemenic Memorizer.
description.elemenix.geological_simulato: The Geological Simulator is an Elemenic Transformer that oxidizes Metallix into Terrix using Flumix by simulating geological processes. The Geological Simulator can automatically deconstruct the pure Flumix items and pure Metallix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Flumix and Metallix into Terrix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Terrix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Terrix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the Mineralizing Mode can be enabled to combine mineral items and rock-type blocks into their corresponding ore blocks, a process that consumes Flumix.
description.elemenix.germinal_accelerato: The Germinal Accelerator is an Elemenic Transformer that provides the environment necessary for the genesis of life, cultivating Flumix and Terrix into living Organix. The Germinal Accelerator can automatically deconstruct the pure Terrix items and pure Flumix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Terrix and Flumix into Organix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Organix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Organix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the Germinating Mode can be enabled to use a plant-type item as a gene template to obtain all its related natural derivatives, a process that consumes Flumix and Terrix.
description.elemenix.memorizer_box: The Memorizer Box is a small container used to carry multiple memorizers at once, and can be placed in the player's box slot. A single Memorizer Box can hold 18 memorizer-type items, such as the Elemenic Memorizer and the Witchcraft Memorizer.
description.elemenix.memorizer_replicato: The Memorizer Replicator is a device for automatically replicating memorizers. At the cost of a small amount of Energix, it automatically adds the same item memory list as the specified memorizer to an empty memorizer. When it receives a redstone signal, its replication function is locked.
description.elemenix.memory_burner: The Memory Burner is used to edit the item sequence stored in an Elemenic Memorizer or Witchcraft Memorizer. It allows operations such as moving, swapping, and deleting items, and supports copying or merging the list to another memorizer of the same type.
description.elemenix.memory_registrar: The Memory Registrar is an integrated device for registering and viewing registered information. The player can place it on the ground and insert an Elemenic Memorizer or Witchcraft Memorizer, after which the registrar will automatically register the items memorized in the memorizer. Afterwards, the player can open the registrar to view the information of all the items they have registered.
description.elemenix.metallix_essence: Metallix is the very cell of every metal and alloy, forging the sharpest blades and the sturdiest armor in the world. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Metallix can be condensed into Metallix Essence for storage.
description.elemenix.metallix_essenplex: Metallix is the very cell of every metal and alloy, forging the sharpest blades and the sturdiest armor in the world. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Metallix can be condensed into Metallix Essenplex for storage.
description.elemenix.metallurgical_activ: The Metallurgical Activator is an Elemenic Transformer capable of reducing Terrix back into Metallix using the immense energy contained within Energix. The Metallurgical Activator can automatically deconstruct the pure Terrix items and pure Energix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Terrix and Energix into Metallix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Metallix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Metallix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the Imitforging Mode can be enabled to replace the appearance of a specific type of item with another item's appearance, a process that consumes Energix.
description.elemenix.optical_capturer: The Optical Capturer is an Elemenic Transformer. It accelerates the photosynthesis of Organix using Flumix, converting the captured light energy into Energix. The Optical Capturer can automatically deconstruct the pure Organix items and pure Flumix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Organix and Flumix into Energix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Energix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Energix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet.
description.elemenix.organix_essence: Organix is the raw material from which the spirit of nature weaves foliage and flesh, holding the very mechanism of life's birth and operation. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Organix can be condensed into Organix Essence for storage.
description.elemenix.organix_essenplex: Organix is the raw material from which the spirit of nature weaves foliage and flesh, holding the very mechanism of life's birth and operation. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Organix can be condensed into Organix Essenplex for storage.
description.elemenix.piston_pump: The Piston Pump is a positive-displacement, high-pressure, low-flow pump that relies on the reciprocating motion of a piston within the pump cylinder, periodically changing the pump chamber volume to achieve liquid intake and discharge. It is used to craft the Elemenic Pressurized Outlet and the Elemenic Ejector.
description.elemenix.printer_nozzle: The Printer Nozzle is a component installed in printers that extrudes molten elemenix at a certain aperture and deposits it layer by layer to form shapes. It is used to craft the Substance Printer and the Witchcraft Printer.
description.elemenix.remote_elemenic_sto: The Remote Elemenic Storage is used to remotely access elemenix from an Elemenic Storage. This item does not directly store any elemenix itself; it merely provides the player with a method to transfer the elemenix reserves without retrieving the storage unit. The player must place an Elemenic Storage into an Elemenic Infuser, then bind it with the Remote Elemenic Storage for it to take effect.
description.elemenix.scanning_storage: The Scanning Storage can quickly deconstruct all items in a container block and store them. This process is also considered as opening the container, which can trigger the opening effects of special containers such as trapped chests. During this process, unanalysable items in the container are ignored.
description.elemenix.substance_printer: The Substance Printer is a device block used to automate item reconstruction. It reconstructs the stored elemenix into items according to the Elemenic Memorizer placed inside it, following a specified order. When it receives a redstone signal, its reconstruction function is locked.
description.elemenix.terrix_essence: Terrix is the smallest constituent of the vast earth, from which every grain of sand and clod of soil builds the planet's every brick and tile. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Terrix can be condensed into Terrix Essence for storage.
description.elemenix.terrix_essenplex: Terrix is the smallest constituent of the vast earth, from which every grain of sand and clod of soil builds the planet's every brick and tile. Through the enriching functions of various instruments, Terrix can be condensed into Terrix Essenplex for storage.
description.elemenix.throttle_valve: The Throttle Valve is a valve that controls fluid flow by changing the throttle cross-section or throttle length, and is used to craft the Elemenic Outlet.
description.elemenix.transforming_chip: The Transforming Chip is an essential component for elemenic transformation, and is used to craft the five different Elemenic Transformers.
description.elemenix.transpiring_inciner: The Transpiring Incinerator is an Elemenic Transformer. Using the thermal energy provided by Energix, it intensifies the transpiration process of Organix, generating large amounts of Flumix. The Transpiring Incinerator can automatically deconstruct the pure Organix items and pure Energix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Organix and Energix into Flumix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Flumix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Flumix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet.
description.elemenix.witchcraft_memorize: The Witchcraft Memorizer is the potion version of the Elemenic Memorizer. When placed into the corresponding slot of an Elemenic Analyzer, the potion-type items deconstructed by the analyzer will be memorized by it. Afterwards, the analyzer can be used to reconstruct the memorized potion-type items. Honeycomb can be used to set the Witchcraft Memorizer to read-only mode to prevent other players from modifying its memories. The player who set it to read-only can use an axe to remove its read-only state.
description.elemenix.witchcraft_printer: The Witchcraft Printer is a device block used to automate the reconstruction of potion-type items. It reconstructs the stored elemenix into potion-type items according to the Witchcraft Memorizer placed inside it, following a specified order. When it receives a redstone signal, its reconstruction function is locked.
description.elemenix.witchcraft_trove: The Witchcraft Trove is the source of knowledge of the witch clan, containing generations of accumulated potion-brewing experience. After the player kills a witch, there is a chance to drop the Witchcraft Trove, which is used to craft the Witchcraft Memorizer and the Witchcraft Printer.
description.elemenix.wrench: The Wrench is an indispensable tool for every elemenic engineer. The player can right-click with the Wrench to reverse the direction of an Elemenic Channel and view the state of the transport pathway connected to an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the player can sneak and right-click an Elemenic Comparator with the Wrench to record its criteria, then copy them to other comparators.
